subject: Kraken
text: Kraken yields 199 EXP and 150+ GP, attacks with tentacles, and its preferred weapon is the Thunder Spear.

evidence.quote: EXP gained:         199...GP:                 150+...Attacks:            Tentacles...Preferred Weapon:   Thunder Spear

subject: Kraken
text: To defeat Kraken, attack its head and then quickly move out of the way of its tentacles.

evidence.quote: The strategy here is to attack then retreat. You must hit its head then quickly move out of the way of its tentacles.

subject: Floor switches
text: Cutting away the herbs around both switches and placing 2 knight snowmen onto them makes a ladder appear in the lower right corner.

evidence.quote: Here, Hack away all the herbs around both switches. Now, you can kill the Dark Mages if there are some but leave the knights alive. You have to turn 2 of them into snowmen and place them over the switches... If you successfully placed 2 snowmen on the switches, a ladder will appear in the lower right corner.

subject: Zeus Axe
text: In the room south of the locked door past the lava pool, defeating all enemies makes a chest appear containing the Zeus Axe.

evidence.quote: Once you reach dry land, use a key and go south one screen. Here, kill all of the enemies and a chest will appear in the middle. It’s the most powerful Axe in the game. The Zeus Axe!

subject: Floor switches
text: Turning any 2 monsters into snowmen with Ice Magic and pushing them onto the floor switches reveals a ladder.

evidence.quote: Here, turn any 2 monsters into snowmen and push them on to the floor switches. After placing 2 snowmen on the switches, a ladder will appear.

subject: Iflyte
text: Iflyte yields 223 EXP and 264 GP, attacks with a rolling attack, and its preferred weapon is the Thunder Spear.

evidence.quote: EXP gained:         223...GP:                 264...Attacks:            Rolling Attack...Preferred Weapon:   Thunder Spear

subject: Iflyte
text: Against Iflyte, attack him using the Spear and dodge when he performs his rolling attack.

evidence.quote: Iflyte is very easy. Just attack him using the Spear. When he does his rolling attack, just dodge it.

subject: Rusty Sword
text: After defeating Iflyte, examine the chest that appears in the middle to obtain the Rusty Sword.

evidence.quote: After beating Iflyte, a chest will appear in the middle. Examine it to get the Rusty Sword.

subject: Chocobot
text: If the chocobot is stuck in the upper left corner of the world map behind rocks, leave the screen and return to be able to talk to it again.

evidence.quote: There’s a glitch here. If you arrive in the world map and the chocobot is in the upper left corner, you can’t talk to it because the rocks get in the way. All you have to do is to leave this screen and come back again and talk to the chocobot and take it with you again.

subject: Cave of Ruins
text: The Cave of Ruins is hidden under a crystal in the Desert of Crystal and requires the Nuke Magic obtained from Lich in the Palmy Desert to destroy the crystal.

evidence.quote: If you went to Bowow, you’ll know that the Cave of Ruins is hidden beneath one of the crystals in the Desert of Crystal and you’ll need a very powerful magic to destroy the crystal covering the entrance. It is the Nuke Magic. Bowow will tell you to beat Lich at the Palmy Desert.

subject: Lich
text: Before fighting Lich in the Cave of Palmy Desert, fully restore HP and MP and equip the Flame Flail for fast attacks that can hit Lich multiple times.

evidence.quote: Before going north, make sure your HP and MP are FULL as you’ll meet one of the most damaging enemy in the game! I suggest that you use the Flame Flail as it has a fast attack and can hit Lich many times.

subject: Lich
text: Lich yields 196 EXP and 204 GP, attacks by throwing skulls, is weak to the Flame Flail, and can be hit on any part of his body.

evidence.quote: EXP gained:         196...GP:                 204...Attacks:            Skulls...Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail...The only advantage Lich can give you is that, you can hit Lich on any part of his body.

subject: Lich
text: Lich's skulls can be hit with weapons, and touching Lich directly inflicts a very large amount of damage.

evidence.quote: And most of all, DON’T EVER TOUCH HIM! You’ll receive a very large amount of damage!...Note: You can hit the Skulls with your weapons.

subject: Nuke Magic
text: After defeating Lich, the player receives the Nuke Magic.

evidence.quote: After the battle, you’ll now receive the Nuke Magic.

subject: Cave of Ruins entrance
text: In the Desert of Crystal, using Nuke Magic to blast the crystal on the right reveals 2 crystals in the area and opens the Cave of Ruins.

evidence.quote: Here, you’ll see 2 crystals in the middle. Use your Nuke and blast the one on the right. A cave opening should now appear. Enter it and you’ll be in the Cave of Ruins.

subject: Dragon Shield
text: In the Cave of Ruins, navigate the slippery floors to the right to obtain the Dragon Shield.

evidence.quote: In here, use the slippery floors and go right one screen. You can now get the 2nd best shield in the game, the Dragon Shield.

subject: Dragon Sword
text: In the Cave of Ruins, heading north two screens and left two screens leads to the Dragon Sword.

evidence.quote: This time, go north two screen. In here, go left two screens. Now, you’ll get the Dragon Sword.

subject: Mantis Ant
text: Mantis Ant yields 214 EXP and 229 GP, attacks with a charging attack, and is best fought inside the lightning barrier using the Flame Flail.

evidence.quote: EXP gained:         214...GP:                 229...Attacks:            Charging Attack...Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail...You’ll have to cross the lightning barrier so that you’ll be in the middle. When you’re inside, cure at once and then hack away with your Flame Flail.

subject: Rusty Sword
text: Stepping on the floor switch while the Rusty Sword is equipped releases its power and causes the Dime Tower to emerge in the desert.

evidence.quote: After that, equip the Rusty Sword and go right one screen. In here, step on the Floor Switch while you have the Rusty Sword Equipped. It will release it’s power now... Dime Tower should now appear somewhere in this desert.

subject: Dime Tower
text: Entering Dime Tower is a point of no return with no access to the world map afterward, so players should rest at the Ish inn and purchase 8 sets of Keys beforehand.

evidence.quote: This will now be your last time to see the World Map. You can buy Equipments and Items (especially Keys). So, go visit Ish one last time. Once there, sleep at the Inn and buy Keys until you have 8 sets of it in your inventory. If you’re ready, let’s head for the Dime Tower. I repeat, there’s no turning back now.

subject: Marcie
text: Upon entering Dime Tower, the robot Marcie created 50 years ago joins and restores the player's MP.

evidence.quote: upon entering, you’ll see Marcie. A robot created by Dr. Bowow 50 years ago. She’ll be able to help you by restoring your MPs! Wow! Unlimited Magic!

subject: Floor switches
text: In the room with 4 floor switches in the middle, use the Flail to cross and step on all switches to open the north door.

evidence.quote: In the screen with 4 floor switches in the middle, use your Flail to go in the middle. Just step on all floor switches and the door to the north will open.

subject: Dragon Armor
text: From Point AA in Dime Tower, use a key to go north one screen and right one screen to obtain the Dragon Armor from the chest in the middle.

evidence.quote: Now, equip a key then go north one screen. Next, go right one screen. You can now get the Dragon Armor from the chest in the middle.

subject: Tree puzzle
text: Hack the 2 trees covering 2 monsters with an axe without hitting them, then use Ice to turn them into snowmen and open the north door.

evidence.quote: In the next area, equip your axe and hack the 2 trees that are covering the 2 monsters. Be careful not to hit them. If you accidentally killed one of them, just save and then restart the game again. Now, once the trees are gone, use your Ice and turn them into snowmen. The north door will now open.
